description: Header file defining the VP8 VAAPI video encoder delegate class, including its methods, data members, and related structures for VP8 video encoding using VAAPI in Chromium.

classes.name: VP8VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate
classes.description: A class that manages VP8 video encoding via VAAPI, including rate control, frame header setup, and reference frame management.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with given configuration.

methods.name: UpdateRates
methods.description: Updates the bitrate and framerate settings.

methods.name: GetCodedSize
methods.description: Returns the coded size of the video frames.

methods.name: GetMaxNumOfRefFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of reference frames.

methods.name: GetSVCLayerResolutions
methods.description: Returns the resolutions of SVC layers.

methods.name: InitializeFrameHeader
methods.description: Initializes the frame header for encoding.

methods.name: SetFrameHeader
methods.description: Sets the frame header parameters for a specific frame.

methods.name: UpdateReferenceFrames
methods.description: Updates reference frames after encoding a frame.

methods.name: PrepareEncodeJob
methods.description: Prepares an encode job with current settings.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for the encoded frame.

methods.name: BitrateControlUpdate
methods.description: Updates rate control based on encoded frame metadata.
